class.name: UZUVfx
class.brief_description: Composite visual effects (explosions, lasers) fired from declarative recipes in one call.
class.description: [UZUVfx] is U.ZU Engine's recipe-driven visual effects: a composite effect is declared as data — a [Dictionary] of parts with parameters — instead of code, and fired with one call. The parts are sparks, smoke, debris (small meshes on parabolic paths; there is no destruction simulation), a shockwave ring, a beam and a point-light flash, plus the [UZUJuice] parts (shake, hitstop, kick) and a synthesized [UZUSfx] sound, each with its own [code]delay[/code]. [codeblock] # The built-in explosion, at a position: UZUVfx.fire_named(self, Vector3(2, 1, 0), "explosion") # A custom recipe, beamed from a muzzle to a target: var recipe := {"name": "shot", "parts": [ {"type": "beam", "color": [1, 0.4, 0.2]}, {"type": "sparks", "at": "target", "count": 12}, {"type": "sfx", "preset": "laser"}]} UZUVfx.fire_between(self, muzzle.global_position, target.global_position, recipe) [/codeblock] Every parameter has a default and a range; [method validate_recipe] is a pure function that fills the defaults, clamps out-of-range values (reported as warnings) and rejects unknown types, keys and values (reported as errors), so an agent can check a recipe and read back its normalized parts and total duration without a scene tree. Fired effects are tracked as pure age/duration values ([method get_active_effects]) and free themselves when their life ends. [code]flash[/code] and [code]squash[/code] are not recipe parts: they need a specific target node, which a positional recipe does not have — call [UZUJuice] for those. [b]Note:[/b] This class is specific to U.ZU Engine (UZUVfx, BACKLOG B-1109).

method.name: clear_effects
method.description: Frees every live effect now, instead of waiting for their durations to end.

method.name: describe_recipe
method.description: A built-in recipe (see [method get_recipe_names]), validated and normalized — the same shape [method validate_recipe] returns — or a Dictionary with [code]ok = false[/code] and an [code]error[/code] for an unknown name.

method.name: fire
method.description: Fires [param recipe] under [param parent] at [param origin]. A beam part uses its [code]direction[/code] and [code]length[/code]; parts with [code]at = "target"[/code] sit at the origin. Returns the validation result plus [code]effect[/code] (the spawned root node), [code]part_types[/code] and [code]duration[/code]; an invalid recipe fires nothing and returns [code]ok = false[/code] with the errors.

method.name: fire_between
method.description: Like [method fire], but a beam part spans from [param origin] to [param target], and parts with [code]at = "target"[/code] spawn at [param target].

method.name: fire_named
method.description: Fires the built-in recipe [param name] (see [method get_recipe_names]) at [param origin]; an unknown name returns [code]ok = false[/code] with an [code]error[/code].

method.name: get_active_count
method.description: How many fired effects are alive right now.

method.name: get_active_effects
method.description: The live effects as pure values: one Dictionary per effect with [code]name[/code], [code]age[/code], [code]duration[/code], [code]remaining[/code] and [code]parts[/code] (the part types, in recipe order).

method.name: get_recipe
method.description: The built-in recipe [param name] as declared (defaults not filled in), or an empty Dictionary for an unknown name.

method.name: validate_recipe
method.description: Checks [param recipe] and normalizes it, without touching the scene tree: the result has [code]ok[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]errors[/code], [code]warnings[/code] (values clamped into their ranges), [code]parts[/code] (the normalized parts, every parameter filled with its default) and [code]duration[/code] (the effect's total life in seconds, including delays and a short particle tail). Part types: [code]sparks[/code], [code]smoke[/code], [code]debris[/code], [code]ring[/code], [code]beam[/code], [code]light[/code], [code]shake[/code], [code]hitstop[/code], [code]kick[/code], [code]sfx[/code].
